## Projects

- [Admin Web Migration](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/runo-admin-web-migration): Migrated the administrative web surface incrementally while ops kept working: shared sheet validation, multi-step upload wizards, and dirty-check wrappers replaced duplicated legacy UI plumbing.
- [Blockchain NGO Donation Tracking](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/blockchain-ngo-donations): Built an Ethereum-based donation tracking prototype at a nonprofit: lifecycle states on-chain, receipt hashes for auditability, MetaMask-signed attestations, without the platform holding custodial keys.
- [Campus Exam Portal](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/piet-quest-portal): Built Campus Quest, a campus examination portal with per-session question/option permutation, focus-loss integrity signals, and bulk question-bank ingestion for faculty.
- [Crickiaa](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/crickiaa): Flutter UI for a gully cricket match management app: OTP-based login, match listing, team creation, and batting/bowling stats screens. Started from Figma-generated scaffolding; real work was adding SVG icons, OTP auth integration, and fixing Android builds.
- [E-commerce Price & Catalog Sync](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/enthral-price-automation): Automated supplier catalog extraction and price-drift detection for an electronics e-commerce store. Margin rules and outlier thresholds produce OpenCart import manifests instead of manual daily price checks.
- [Face Validation API Prototype](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/face-validation-api): Prototype Express API exploring server-side face detection with face-api.js / TensorFlow.js: auth and middleware are solid; the detection route is intentionally unfinished and documented as such.
- [floor_plan_builder, a Flutter package](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/floor-plan-builder): Flutter package for rendering interactive restaurant/venue floor plans from a JSON table list: shapes, availability colors, pinch-to-zoom, and onTableTap callbacks.
- [Hopfield Network Visualization](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/hopfield-network-visualization): Two Jupyter notebooks exploring Hopfield networks: a basic 2-neuron energy landscape demo and an advanced 5x5 grid showing pattern storage and noisy-input recovery with animation. Built with AI assistance while learning the concepts.
- [HTML Content Translator](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/html-content-translator): Python utility that walks an HTML DOM with BeautifulSoup, translates visible text nodes (EN→HI), and leaves tags, attributes, and script/style alone.
- [Hybrid Telephony Workflows](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/runo-hybrid-telephony): Runo already supported SIM-based call tracking and Airtel IQ cloud telephony, but never together; an account got one or the other. This work unified both into one account-level capability, usable simultaneously in the same app.
- [image_hotspot, a Flutter package](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/flutter-image-hotspot): Published a Flutter package for defining interactive, clickable hotspot areas on images, useful for floor plans, diagrams, and annotated photos.
- [Laravel Queue Worker on Shared Hosting](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/laravel-queue-shared-hosting): A small Node.js process manager that spawns and restarts Laravel's queue worker on shared hosting where Supervisor/systemd are unavailable.
- [Manufacturing Inventory Platform Rebuild](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/nmold-inventory-redevelopment): Rebuilt the manufacturing client's inventory tooling from a rigid monolith to Flutter clients over Express/MongoDB, with Node-RED/OPC UA bridging Siemens and Delta PLC telemetry into the same operational picture.
- [My Dua App](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/my-dua-app): Flutter redesign of an existing Islamic app. It consumes a live WordPress REST API for dua/dhikr content, schedules device-local adhan alarms per prayer time (geolocation-based), and streams audio via a persistent bottom-nav player.
- [No-Code ML Environment](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/no-code-ml): Flask app that wraps common supervised-learning pipelines behind a UI: CSV upload, column picker, sklearn regressors or Keras LSTM, then MAE/MSE/RMSE plus a prediction plot.
- [OMR Sheet Automation](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/omr-sheet-automation): Built a staged, fault-tolerant Python OMR pipeline that processed over 90,000 physical examination forms.
- [PHP Ghost Wall](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/php-ghost-wall): Composer package for Laravel that hash-checks a monitored file on every boot, POSTs a tamper alert if it changed, and phones home with server metadata. Built for shared hosting without CI file watchers.
- [Product Analytics Pipeline](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/runo-product-analytics): Built a product analytics telemetry pipeline: a provider abstraction over Amplitude, typed event schemas, Hive-backed client buffering, and sliding-window deduplication.
- [RAG Document Chatbot](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/rag-document-chatbot): Retrieval-augmented chatbot over PDF docs: embed with a hosted model, retrieve top chunks, answer with an LLM constrained to that context. Flask UI, honest notes on global-index limits.
- [Real-time Location Tracker](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/real-time-location-tracker): Browser GPS sharing over Socket.IO: every connected client broadcasts coordinates; a shared Leaflet map shows live markers with device popups and auto-fit bounds.
- [Schema-Driven School CRUD GUI](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/schema-driven-school-crud): Class-project desktop GUI that introspects SQLite at runtime and generates navigation, CRUD forms, and tables dynamically: closer to a tiny low-code engine than hand-built screens.
- [School CMS on Shared Hosting](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/gmssss-laravel-school-website): Production school CMS: Laravel 11 and Filament v3 with RBAC, galleries, announcements, webhook auto-deploy, and php-ghost-wall integrity checks on shared hosting.
- [Smart Irrigation IoT](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/smart-irrigation-iot): Built a soil/climate irrigation setup: NodeMCU sensors publish to Firebase, a Flutter dashboard visualizes the stream, and an SVM model drives pump actuation with hard edge cutoffs if the cloud path stalls.
- [WhatsApp Web CRM Sidecar](https://vishalxtyagi.in/work/runo-whatsapp-crm-sidecar): Built a Manifest V3 Chrome extension that syncs WhatsApp Web conversations into a CRM by resolving the app's own internal module stores at runtime, and pages chat history without ever changing the chat a rep is looking at.
